title: Captured fuel endpoint as a controller frame
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a Boolean fuel machine on input $x$, and suppose $c$ is halted. Its captured, relocated configuration equals the loop-host frame built over that captured configuration, in controller phase zero, with input-head position inherited from $c$, blank flag and counter tapes, a payload tape containing the output of $c$ from cell zero onward, the flag head at zero, the counter head at the output length, and empty output.
replaced:
Let $c$ be a halted configuration of the fuel machine. The captured fuel endpoint of the
loop host equals the controller frame over itself in phase zero whose flag and counter
tracks are blank, whose payload track is the buffer tape of the output of $c$ with
payload head at its length, with the input head of $c$ and empty output.
